records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated painted PNG sprite for a Russian fairy-tale mobile game's navigation card, rendered at about 203 by 222 logical pixels in Unity. Generate a brand-new independent resource, not a scene or screenshot. Square canvas with genuine transparent alpha outside the entire card. A substantial, physically sculpted frame encloses an intentionally opaque deep black-navy lacquer inset. Frame fills x4–96% and y3–97%. It has transparent padding around every tip. Overall silhouette is an irregular clipped-corner octagon with convex cast-gold corners, thick layered bevels, deeply recessed black crevices and small carved Slavic leaf scrolls. Its rails must be broad and weighty, not thin tidy rectangular lines: each rail roughly 6% canvas width, with chunky corner thickness 10%. Deep antique bronze #654018 and aged gold #a77329 dominate, localized rich warm highlights #e7bb59, tiny bright glints; never uniform pale yellow metal. The lower section is a WIDE projecting horizontal near-black navy caption plaque across virtually the entire canvas, from x3% to x97%, from y76% to y91%, OVERLAYING and hiding the lower frame rails. Its thin antique-gold border lies outside a completely flat EMPTY NAVY RECTANGLE x7–93%, y78–89%. The plaque projects beyond both side rails, with tiny clipped corners only at its outermost ends. Do not let thick ornamental corners intrude into this wide blank rectangle; place lower ornamental flourishes below y93%. This extraordinarily wide empty lower plaque is essential for long live Cyrillic labels. No text, letters, numbers, fake glyphs or notification badges anywhere. All subject artwork is restricted to x12–88%, y11–72%. A single tiny blue sapphire in antique-gold setting at top center and a restrained bottom finial below the caption plate. Picture treatment: highly polished painterly fantasy realism with tangible relief, warm side lighting, deep cast shadows, visibly engraved metal. The navy inset is #030a12 to #071527 with restrained reflected light, no saturated royal-blue field. True alpha exterior only, not a checkerboard picture, no environment or drop-shadow rectangle. Framing must keep all ornament intact with several transparent pixels all around.
Subject: A weathered parchment world map stands upright rotated6degrees clockwise. The LEFT edge rolls into a large upright golden-brown scroll, irregular curled right edge; muted sepia mountains/rivers are painted on mottled parchment, without writing. A gold/brass compass with radial needles leans against the lower-left map. Group contained x17–84%, y14–72%.
Output one complete isolated card. Genuine transparent exterior alpha; do not draw a checkerboard. No image input is being supplied: create an independent new painting.
records.mode: built-in imagegen; fresh text-only independent painting
records.referenceRole: Original whole Home.png and actual R4 Unity portrait directly inspected by agent, not supplied as pixel inputs; text prompt reflects frame material, perspective and subject.
